name: Dip
common_faults: excessive forward lean causing shoulder impingement

substitutions.note: horizontal press; less shoulder risk for most
similar pattern with lower joint stress

contraindications: shoulder impingement or anterior instability aggravated by shoulder hyperextension
resistance_profile: hardest at the bottom in the stretched position; highest shoulder stress at depth

provenance.notes: Higher shoulder stress than horizontal pressing due to hyperextension at depth. Lean angle determines pec vs tricep emphasis. SFR heuristic.
